body: r32-enterprise (2026-10-07): oauthproxy relays a sealed authorization code, not a profile (the preview exchanges it with its own PKCE verifier, so the proxy secret cannot assert an identity); SCIM is its own handler, not auth.Define operations; SCIM emails start unverified unless TrustEmails(); the device code's user_id is accepted from Go only; oauthpopup is a package inside plugin/oauthproxy.
